text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with transition words like \"However,\" \"For example,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into distinct parts and uses discourse markers to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"\"Curfews interfere with young people's lives because they have to stay at work very late, have to intended to something, and have fun with their friends\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The main claim is stated directly and previewed with reasons in a more controlled way."},{"evidence":"\"Going home on time when they're at work is impossible\" and \"That is one good reason why they shouldn't adopt the curfew\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay expands each point with a fuller explanation rather than repeating the same general claim."},{"evidence":"\"For example, when the teenagers are in a play, they can't stop the play until it's finished\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The writer gives more relevant examples to illustrate and strengthen the argument."},{"evidence":"\"This shows that curfews interfere with young people's lives\"","quality":"cohesive conclusion","description":"The ending restates the argument in a more complete way and ties the reasons back to the claim."}]}
